objective: Qualified discovery, useful content and measurable answer visibility

seo-calendar-refill.expected_when: The routine is due and its scoped report, research or reconciliation has not been verified for the period.
seo-calendar-refill.acceptance: A dated sourced finding, decision or reconciliation is usable by its intended reader.
seo-calendar-refill.fallback: Prepare a sourced canonical-page refresh, buyer-question brief or technical handoff. Use Google Search Console Generative AI impressions separately from sampled answers.
seo-calendar-refill.recovery: Refresh source facts and continue unfinished useful work in the current eligible period.
